server_name.description: Fully qualified hostname of the IRC server (must be resolvable)

server_description.description: Human-readable server description shown in /links and /version

server_network.description: Network name visible in server links and client info

server_network_id.description: Unique lowercase ID for the network (used in STS and other internal references)

limits_max_nick_length.description: Maximum allowed length of a nickname

limits_max_channel_length.description: Maximum length of a channel name

limits_max_message_length.description: Maximum total length of a message line (including prefix and command)

limits_max_bans.description: Maximum number of ban entries per channel

limits_max_modes.description: Maximum number of modes per channel

operators_admin_password_hash.description: Argon2id hash (or similar) of operator's password; never store plaintext

operators_admin_mask.description: User/hostmask pattern that this oper may use to authenticate

listeners_client_tls.description: Whether to use TLS on this listener

listeners_client_tls_cert.description: Path to TLS certificate file (PEM format); required if tls=true

listeners_client_tls_key.description: Path to TLS private key file; required if tls=true

motd.description: Custom Message of the Day to display instead of the default
